status: reference inventory; not a replacement calculation or deployed protocol

semantics.dedicatedPositiveBonus: For each G_Profile_AddScore call separately: (int)(delta * 1.10f), minimum 1 for a positive input. Negative inputs unchanged. Preserve C float32/truncation behavior.
semantics.negativeScores: G_Profile_AddScore adds signed deltas; do not silently clamp the career total to zero.
semantics.achievementAward: newlyUnlocked * 8 is passed in one award call; do not split/regroup calls under the dedicated bonus.
semantics.ordering: Mode guards, event ordering, achievement evaluation, one-time outcome/placement flags and duplicate prevention are part of the reference behavior.
semantics.stableExtension: Open product decision before v1.0: whether new native achievement tiers may use the frozen +8 rule. Existing tier awards remain unchanged. Arcade/cosmetic achievement additions must not silently trigger native career awards.
